PRIVATE: auditor and owner only; never given to the builder, the pipeline, or the automated judge

tiers.K: known-answer: documented failure with established mitigation; score key_elements coverage
tiers.D: debated/open: score feasibility, constraint fit, specificity and non-obviousness; no single right answer

scoring: per problem 0-4 on: question answered, key_elements covered (K) or quality checks met (D), commits to numbers with labelled assumptions, falsifier is testable; plus red-flag penalties

key_elements: acknowledges multi-factor causation (transient torque or slip, hydrogen from lubricant breakdown, stray electrical current) rather than one cause

names at least two retrofit-compatible measures: coated rollers or rings (black oxide or DLC), bearing steel or heat-treatment change, lubricant or additive change, electrical insulation or grounding, control limits on torque reversals
falsification test is a rig or field comparison under transient loading with treated vs untreated bearings and a defined life or crack-count criterion
red_flags: requires a new bearing envelope or gearbox redesign (violates the constraint)

key_elements: temperature- and state-of-charge-dependent charge-current derating instead of one fixed rate
heating before or during cold charge (internal self-heating or thermal system), and handling of the pack temperature gradient
anode-potential-aware charge control (model-based or reference-estimated) keeping anode potential above 0 V vs Li/Li+, or electrolyte/anode design levers
falsification via 0 C cycling with plating detection (voltage plateau/dV/dQ, post-mortem) against a capacity-loss criterion
red_flags: just charge slower everywhere (ignores the 25-minute requirement at 25 C)
ignores thermal gradients across the pack after the follow-up finding

key_elements: identifies TGO (alumina) growth and its stresses at the bond-coat interface as the driver, and frames limits around TGO thickness
bond-coat measures: aluminium reservoir (aluminide or Al-rich MCrAlY), reactive elements (Y, Hf), pre-oxidation to form slow-growing alpha-alumina
strain-tolerant top-coat microstructure (columnar EB-PVD or segmented/dense vertically cracked)
falsification via furnace thermal-cycling to spallation with TGO thickness measured by SEM against the 600-cycle target; after the follow-up, moves toward bond-coat Al depletion
red_flags: changes the substrate alloy or exceeds 400 micrometres

key_elements: seal material and geometry appropriate to minus 25 C (low-temperature elastomer grade or PTFE-based capped seal with energizer, tandem or buffer arrangement, wiper)
explains persistence after warm-up (permanent set, hardening, or damaged sealing lip) rather than only cold stiffness
stays inside the gland dimensions and fluid constraint
falsification via cold-chamber stroke test measuring friction and leakage per stroke
red_flags: changes the fluid grade or rod coating

key_elements: lower-permeability concrete (supplementary cementitious materials, low water-to-cement ratio) and greater cover
corrosion-resistant reinforcement (stainless, GFRP, or equivalent) and/or inhibitors, sealers or membranes; notes epoxy-coated rebar has a mixed field record
service-life reasoning via chloride diffusion modelling or testing, not only material lists
falsification via chloride-profile/diffusion tests plus half-cell or corrosion-rate monitoring against a 75-year projection
red_flags: only says use better concrete without addressing chloride transport
ignores the whole-life cost or closure constraint

key_elements: treatments that retard crack initiation at hole edges: cold expansion or interference-fit fasteners, peening, improved hole quality
addresses fretting and secondary bending at the faying surface (sealant or coating, bonded strap or doubler within the mass limit)
does not replace skin panels or change the outer mould line
falsification via constant- and variable-amplitude coupon fatigue tests with a 2x life or initiation-life criterion
interconnect upgrade: copper wire bonds, ribbons or clips, and/or sintered-silver die attach
reduces thermal-expansion mismatch (matched substrate or baseplate) or reduces the junction-temperature swing by control or cooling
falsification via accelerated power-cycling with on-state voltage and thermal-resistance end-of-life criteria
red_flags: improves cooling only without addressing the swing or interconnect failure mechanisms

key_elements: highly crosslinked UHMWPE with elimination of residual free radicals (remelting or annealing) or antioxidant stabilization (vitamin E)
recognizes the crosslinking versus fatigue-strength trade-off and how stabilization manages it
sterilization route that avoids creating oxidizable radicals (inert-atmosphere irradiation, ethylene oxide, or gas plasma)
falsification via hip-simulator wear, accelerated oxidative ageing and fatigue-crack-propagation tests
targets shrinkage at the bosses: local cooling or spot cooling, squeeze or intensification, gating or overflow redesign
also addresses gas porosity: vacuum assistance, venting, shot profile, melt degassing, die-lubricant gas
treats impregnation as a secondary measure, not the main fix
falsification via CT or X-ray porosity mapping and leak-rate statistics in a designed experiment against the scrap target
red_flags: ignores the stated boss shrinkage location

key_elements: reduces diffusible hydrogen (low-hydrogen consumables, dry shielding and joint cleanliness) toward below about 5 mL per 100 g
preheat and controlled interpass temperature and heat input to slow cooling and let hydrogen escape; post-heat hydrogen release instead of full post-weld heat treatment
uses the follow-up numbers (410 HV10 HAZ, 8 mL per 100 g hydrogen) to justify the changes
falsification via implant, Tekken or controlled-thermal-severity cracking tests and delayed NDT after 48 hours
antioxidant or stabilizer package suited to chlorine/chlorine-dioxide exposure, or a protective inner or barrier layer
considers material alternatives or temperature and dose limits without breaking the fitting dimension constraint
falsification via accelerated pressurized chlorinated-water tests at elevated temperature with life extrapolation to 50 years
separates crossover-driven imbalance from side-reaction drift and proposes a rebalancing (remixing) strategy compatible with no replacement
membrane option with lower vanadium permeability weighed against resistance and efficiency limits
operating-window measures (state-of-charge limits, temperature, pressure balance)
falsification via permeation measurement and capacity-retention cycling against the efficiency floor
breaks or manages the copper-aluminium galvanic couple (isolation, coating, or inhibitor package suited to both metals)
coolant chemistry control and monitoring (inhibitor level, pH, conductivity) and filtration
respects the no-manifold-change and pump-compatibility constraints
falsification via coupon immersion and accelerated loop ageing tracking pressure drop and thermal resistance
surge protection sized by transient analysis: air vessel or surge tank, one-way tank, air and vacuum valves, or controlled non-slam check valves
addresses the down-surge and column separation at the high point as the follow-up shows, not only the up-surge
pump-side measures (flywheel inertia, controlled ramp-down) as options
falsification via method-of-characteristics transient simulation and a staged pump-trip field test with pressure loggers
features from the per-movement current profile (energy or area, peak and inrush, duration, plateau level) trended against each machine's own baseline
a persistence rule and relative threshold, not one fixed absolute value for all machines
retrospective validation on logs with labelled failures, reporting lead time and false alarms per machine-month
cumulative debris count or mass and its rate of rise against each turbine's own post-run-in baseline
confirmation with a vibration feature to cut false alarms
persistence-based threshold expressed as a multiple of baseline rate
retrospective validation against teardown-confirmed damage
red_flags: single fixed absolute count across all turbines

key_elements: uses rest-period voltage decay or self-discharge rate of each cell relative to its siblings after balancing
robust statistical threshold on the cell-to-pack distribution, plus a persistence rule
exploits the stated 6-hour rest window
validation with seeded or emulated shorts plus a fleet false-alarm estimate
red_flags: needs sensors that are not available

key_elements: ESR (or ripple-voltage-to-ripple-current ratio) trended over time as the primary indicator
temperature compensation of the indicator (life roughly halves per 10 C rise)
threshold relative to initial ESR (an end-of-life criterion around 2 times initial) with margin for 6 months of warning
validation by accelerated life test at upper category temperature; after the follow-up accounts for heatsink-proximity temperature differences
red_flags: fixed absolute ESR value regardless of unit or temperature

key_elements: risk indicator combining operating-temperature window (roughly minus 4 to 175 C, highest near cycling or intermittent service), insulation and jacket condition or age, and geometry
screening measurement such as moisture detection or pulsed eddy current to rank segments
validation by strip-and-inspect of a statistical sample with hit-rate and miss-rate against the 10 percent miss limit
fluoride emission rate in the effluent water as the primary chemical-degradation indicator, trended against baseline
complementary online signals: hydrogen-in-oxygen crossover and high-frequency resistance trend
threshold as a sustained multiple of baseline emission rate
validation by accelerated stress testing with post-mortem membrane thickness measurement
barrier-fluid consumption rate and temperature-rise rate normalized by operating condition
barrier-pressure decay as a second indicator
relative-to-baseline threshold with persistence, validated retrospectively on seal-failure history
transmembrane-pressure rise slope at constant ultrafiltration rate and blood flow, relative to the patient's own prior sessions
supporting pre-dialyser pressure trend
validation against measured clearance and clot scoring; avoids prescribing anticoagulant changes as the predictor itself
red_flags: fixed absolute pressure limit for all patients

key_elements: spindle-power trend and a high-frequency vibration band feature, calibrated to flank wear VB by interrupted wear tests
normalizes against each tool's own early baseline and the lot hardness variation instead of one fixed absolute threshold
persistence-based relative threshold giving at least 5 minutes of lead
validation by interrupted wear runs measuring VB under a microscope
red_flags: fixed absolute power threshold ignoring lot variation

key_elements: steam-side oxide scale thickness measurement as the indicator of accumulated metal temperature exposure
converts scale thickness and wall measurements into temperature and stress, then into remaining life via a Larson-Miller type creep-rupture relation
calibration or validation against a few sacrificial tube samples or creep tests, with a stated uncertainty
red_flags: requires removing tubes for all 400 circuits
